# Title: Fix: ReferenceError: window is not defined
# Author: StackHeal Architect
# Date: 2026-05-12
# Canonical URL: https://stackheal.vercel.app/blog/fix-window-not-defined-ssr/

## The Symptom
ReferenceError: window is not defined
  at eval (webpack-internal:///./components/ThemeToggle.js:14:22)

## Root Cause
Modern frameworks generate the initial HTML on a server (Node.js or Edge Runtime) before sending it to the user. The `window`, `document`, and `localStorage` objects only exist inside a user's web browser. When the server tries to read your file and hits the word `window`, it throws a fatal ReferenceError.

## The Cure (Vanilla JS)
Wrap the logic in a type check to tell the server to skip the execution block.

```javascript
// Provide a safe server fallback
let userTheme = 'dark'; 

if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
  // This block is completely ignored by the server.
  // It only executes once it hits the client's browser.
  userTheme = window.localStorage.getItem('theme') || 'dark';
}
